text.text:
Evolve Proline Radial Head System

Radial head replacement system featuring two-part, modular implants designed with a smooth, loose-fitting stem that has been clinically proven in the literature.1,2

text_copy.text:
Evolve Triad Fixation System

Multi-faceted system designed to provide surgeons with different options to address fixation of fractures commonly associated with terrible triad injuries of the elbow. This system includes radial head, radial neck, and coronoid plates in addition to 1.5mm, 2.0mm, and 2.5mm screw options.

largeheadline_copy_c_1165059070.line1:
Smooth, loose-fitting stem
Design rationale

text_copy_copy_copy.text: Toggle of the stem within the radius is designed to allow the radial head to articulate congruently with the capitellum³
Movement of the implant is designed to be guided by the annular ligament rather than by the position of the radial neck³
Loose fit designed to allow the forearm to rotate around the stem rather than at the articular surface of the capitellum

largeheadline_copy_c_1657293279.line1: Options delivered

text_copy.text:
Evolve Proline
Radial Head Prostheses

  • Material: cobalt chrome

  • Modular system with 324 sizing combinations

  • Head diameters: 18mm, 20mm, 22mm, 24mm, 26mm, 28mm

  • Stem diameters: 4.5mm, 5.5mm, 6.5mm, 7.5mm, 8.5mm, 9.5mm

  • All head and stem sizes are available with 3 height options

standaloneimage.alt: Evolve Triad Radial Head and Neck Plates

text_copy_copy.text:
Evolve Triad
Radial Head and Neck Plates

  • Material: stainless steel

  • Ortholoc Mini Polyaxial locking design allows for up to a 20° cone of variable angle locking

  • All round holes accept 2.0mm locking and non-locking screws

  • Radial head plate sizes: 20mm, 22mm, 24mm, 26 mm

  • Radial neck plate sizes: 21mm, 25mm

Evolve Triad
Coronoid Plates

  • Material: stainless steel

  • Available in small, medium, and large

  • Designed to be cut to size and contoured to wrap around and buttress the coronoid

  • Accept 2.0mm bone screws only

Evolve Triad
Screw Options

  • Material: stainless steel

  • 2.5mm cannulated screws: 10-50mm*

  • 2.0mm locking screws: 10-30mm*, 35mm, 40mm

  • 2.0mm bone screws: 10-30mm*, 35mm, 40mm

  • 1.5mm bone screws: 10-28mm*

 

*available in 2mm increments
